title: Two men face each other in a tiled washroom
global_prompt: Four five-second shots preserve the entrance, turn by the sinks, gesturing approach, and reverse reaction in the same washroom.

observed_facts.text: The bespectacled man wears a dark jacket over a blue collared shirt and brown knit layer, framed by white rectangular tiles and a pale door with reversed lettering.
The door opens farther and the man emerges from partial occlusion into the doorway, then holds position with furrowed brows and changing open-mouth expressions.

shots.observed_camera: Steady medium framing toward the doorway, with the man right of center and tiled wall filling the left. No internal edited view change is evident.
shots.action_temporality: Opening and emergence occur in frames 0–2; frames 2–4 support a brief stationary facial reaction.
uncertainties: No audible words or precise gaze target can be established.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In a dim communal washroom lined with white rectangular tiles, a pale door swings farther open. The Bespectacled man, a light-skinned adult with short dark hair and thin metal-framed glasses, emerges wearing an oversized dark jacket over a blue collared shirt and brown knit layer. Hold a medium view with the doorway right of center and the tiled wall on the left. He pauses at the threshold, brows drawn together, lips parting as he looks into the room. Warm light from behind the door contrasts with the cooler washroom.

adaptations.text: Extend the entrance and subsequent pause from roughly 2.6 seconds to five seconds.

observed_facts.text: The dark-shirted man has spiky black hair, a thin dark necklace, and a glossy dark shirt open at the chest. Colored notices appear on the initial wall; a large white-framed mirror, divided upper windows, and sinks appear in subsequent framing.

Initially looking downward, the man turns through a back-facing position, then faces toward the camera's right, raises a hand in an emphatic gesture, and lowers his arms while holding a wide-eyed look.

shots.observed_camera: Medium framing shifts laterally with the turning man from the notice-covered wall toward the mirror. Shared notices, wall rail, and mirror edge support continuous reframing across frames 0–2; subsequent framing settles. No internal cut is evident.
shots.action_temporality: Frames 0–2 show the turn and raised gesture; frames 3–4 show the man settling with his arms lowered.
uncertainties: A small blurred item near his hand cannot be reliably identified and is omitted from the script.
Exact camera mechanism and intervening gesture trajectory are unavailable.
shots.generation_prompt_en: The Dark-shirted man stands inside the same washroom: a light-skinned adult with spiky black hair, slight facial hair, a thin dark necklace, and a glossy nearly black shirt open at the chest. He looks down, turns with his back briefly toward the viewer, and swings around to face toward the right beside the sinks. He lifts one hand in a quick emphatic gesture, then lowers his arms and fixes a wide-eyed look ahead. The surrounding washroom includes colored wall notices and a broad white-framed mirror beneath high divided windows. Let the turn and gesture settle into a short pause.

adaptations.text: Allow five seconds for the approximately four-second turn and gesture, extending the final settled pose; omit the unidentifiable hand-held detail.

observed_facts.text: The dark-shirted man's back occupies the left foreground while the bespectacled man faces him near the lettered door. White tiles, a round caged wall light, a wall-mounted box with a brown bottle, and part of a sink occupy the background.

The bespectacled man advances toward the dark-shirted man, initially extending one pointing hand, then bringing both hands forward in changing gestures before lowering them as he reaches a closer facing position.

shots.observed_camera: Over-the-shoulder view past the dark-shirted man toward the doorway. The approaching man grows larger in frame; this does not require an inferred camera push. No internal cut is evident.
shots.action_temporality: The ordered frames show decreasing distance between the men and successive pointing, open-handed, and lowered-hand poses.
uncertainties: Changing mouth shapes do not establish specific dialogue.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Look past the Dark-shirted man's back and left shoulder toward the Bespectacled man in the same white-tiled washroom. The Bespectacled man stands near the pale lettered door, still wearing his glasses, oversized dark jacket, blue shirt, and brown knit layer. He advances toward the Dark-shirted man with an intent, tense expression, extending one pointing hand and then bringing both hands forward in animated gestures. As he closes the distance, his hands lower and he remains facing the other man. A round caged wall light and the edge of a sink remain visible to the right.

adaptations.text: Slightly lengthen the approximately 4.5-second approach to five seconds while retaining the observed gesture sequence.

observed_facts.text: The dark-shirted man faces the bespectacled man, whose cropped head, glasses, and jacket occupy the right foreground. The broad white mirror frame and high divided windows repeat the sink-side view.
The dark-shirted man maintains widened eyes and an upright posture while his mouth changes shape, ending with his lips closed.

shots.observed_camera: Stable reverse medium view with the dark-shirted man in focus left of center and the bespectacled man cropped in the right foreground. No internal cut is evident.
shots.action_temporality: A short continuous facial response is visible across all five samples; no larger action is established.
uncertainties: The source reaction lasts only approximately 1.4 seconds; a longer reaction is a generation adaptation.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Reverse to the Dark-shirted man beside the washroom mirror, with the Bespectacled man's cropped glasses, cheek, and dark jacket in the right foreground. Keep the Dark-shirted man's spiky hair, thin necklace, and glossy open-collared shirt consistent. He stands upright facing the other man, eyes wide, lips moving briefly before closing. Hold the remaining moment on his alert, still expression. The white mirror surround and high divided windows anchor the same sink area.

adaptations.text: Extend the approximately 1.4-second facial response to five seconds by holding the final closed-mouth expression.

title: Partner dancing beside a small bar stage
global_prompt: Four five-second shots alternate between the small illuminated stage and the adjoining bar floor, retaining the supported dance poses, the blonde woman's changing position among the dancers, and the recurring stage observer.

observed_facts.text: A small raised stage has pink-red curtains, a black backdrop, magenta, cyan and green overhead lamps, and a folding chair to the right. Saturated blue light falls across the foreground dancers.

The swept-haired dance partner supports the loose-haired dancer around her waist and upper leg. Across the samples their orientation changes; she extends one leg almost horizontally to the right and changes her arm pose, ending with one arm raised and the other extended.
The loose-haired dancer appears more upright with her hair flung outward in frame 3, between the supported poses. The precise lowering and lifting sequence is not sampled.
The long-haired stage man stands behind the dancers with his hands near waist level. A translucent yellow-green curved streak appears near his hands in the later frames.

shots.observed_camera: Medium-wide view toward the stage, with dancers close to the lens and the standing man behind them. The stage shifts within the framing across the samples, consistent with modest reframing; an exact camera path is not established. No sampled internal edit is apparent.
shots.action_temporality: Multiple samples support changing partnered dance poses and orientation, but neither the exact lift transitions nor the number or direction of turns is established.
uncertainties: The yellow-green streak's physical nature and cause are unclear and are omitted from the prompt.
shots.generation_prompt_en: A five-second view of partner dancing in a dim bar before a small raised stage framed by pink-red curtains, a black backdrop and magenta, cyan and green lamps. The swept-haired dance partner, a bearded man in plain black long sleeves, supports the loose-haired dancer, a woman with wavy light-brown hair in a short black long-sleeved dance outfit and pale shoes. They turn through a brief supported pose: her bare leg stretches nearly horizontally outward, her torso arches, and one arm reaches overhead while the other opens sideways. Keep the pair prominent in the foreground. Behind them, the long-haired stage man stands in an open dark jacket, blue shirt with a reflective chest detail and slim dark trousers, hands near his waist; a folding chair sits at stage right. Deep blue light and magenta edges color the figures.

adaptations.text: Extend the 4.171-second source to five seconds using one brief supported turn; omit the incompletely sampled upright-to-lift transition.

observed_facts.text: The blonde woman in gray is initially alone in the foreground beside a pale bar counter. Baskets lined with pink-and-white checked paper, a green glass, bottles and small warm lights establish the bar setting.
She turns her head from a rightward-facing three-quarter view toward the left between the first two frames.
The curly-haired man appears close beside her; her arm lies across his shoulders. Their upper bodies change position together along the counter, with the bun-haired dancer partly visible behind them.
The curly-haired man smiles while the blonde woman has parted lips and looks outward. The final framing closely overlaps their faces in profile.

shots.observed_camera: Begins as a medium close view of the blonde woman at the counter, then reframes with the close group into overlapping profiles. Changing counter and pendant-light positions support camera reframing alongside the subjects; exact translation versus rotation cannot be determined. The samples show no clear internal cut.
shots.action_temporality: The ordered frames establish her head turn, the man's appearance beside her, and subsequent movement together. Legs and the exact support arrangement remain outside the framing.
uncertainties: The images do not establish whether she is being lifted; the prompt specifies only visible upper-body contact.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In the same dim bar, begin close on the blonde woman in gray: straight center-parted blonde hair, a fitted gray ribbed short-sleeved shirt, small earrings and a delicate necklace. She turns her head left beside a pale counter holding checked-paper food baskets and a green glass; bottles and warm pinpoints of light soften into the background. The curly-haired man, with high dark curls, a full beard and black clothing with a small bow tie, comes close beside her. Her arm rests across his shoulders as they shift together along the counter. The bun-haired dancer, wearing a black high-necked outfit with her hair pulled into a low bun, stays partly visible behind them. Reframe with the group into close overlapping profiles, his smile beside her parted lips and outward gaze, under blue and magenta light. Complete this short progression in five seconds.

adaptations.text: Compress the 6.09-second progression into five seconds, retaining the head turn and shoulder contact without specifying unseen lower-body choreography.

observed_facts.text: The view returns to the same curtained stage and colored overhead lamps. The long-haired stage man stands with feet apart near its front edge, with a folding chair and keyboard-like fixture behind him.

In front of the stage, the swept-haired partner carries the loose-haired dancer in a deep backward-arched position, her hair hanging down and a leg extended. Their orientation changes and they move toward the left side of the frame.

The blonde woman and curly-haired man enter the near foreground from the left, seen largely from behind with her arm across his shoulders. The bun-haired dancer is beside them in the last sample, and the grouping partly blocks the stage.
The stage man's hands change position around waist height while a translucent yellow-green loop or streak changes shape in front of him.

shots.observed_camera: Wider stage-facing composition shows the stage step and colored pools on the floor. The framing adjusts laterally as dancers cross, while the stage remains the background anchor. No distinct internal edited view is evident.
shots.action_temporality: Frames 0–2 support a carried, turning pose moving left; frames 3–4 show the separate blonde woman's grouping replacing it in the foreground. These are different visible groups, not a costume or identity change.
uncertainties: The green loop's origin is unresolved and omitted.
The blonde woman's lower-body support remains obscured.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Return to a wider five-second view of the same small stage, its pink-red curtains and magenta, cyan and green lamps casting colored pools across the floor and front step. The long-haired stage man stands with feet apart near the edge, making small hand movements at waist height; the folding chair remains behind him at the right. In the foreground, the swept-haired dance partner turns while supporting the loose-haired dancer in a deep backward arch, her hair hanging down and one leg extended. Their pair moves toward the left. The blonde woman in gray and the curly-haired man then occupy the near foreground, mostly seen from behind, her arm across his shoulders, with the bun-haired dancer alongside. Their close grouping partly obscures the standing stage man. Keep the two dance groupings visually distinct.

adaptations.text: Stretch the 4.338-second source to five seconds with a single supported turn followed by the second group's foreground passage.

observed_facts.text: A close side view shows the curly-haired man beside the blonde woman, her arm across his shoulder, with the bun-haired dancer behind them. The pale bar counter and small warm lights remain in the background.

The curly-haired man's back occludes much of the blonde woman in frame 1. The bun-haired dancer crosses the foreground in frame 2. By frame 3 the blonde woman stands clearly visible without the shoulder contact.

The blonde woman looks downward and then outward, her expression changing to a small smile in the last sample. Blue light washes her hair and one side of her shirt while magenta colors the other side.
The swept-haired partner and loose-haired dancer appear behind the blonde woman in the later samples; the loose-haired dancer extends an arm outward in the last frame.

shots.observed_camera: Close moving composition shifts from overlapping side profiles to a frontal medium view of the blonde woman. Foreground bodies briefly occlude her during the reframing. Shared lighting and people support continuity through these occlusions; no positive evidence of an internal cut appears.
shots.action_temporality: The samples support the close grouping breaking apart and the blonde woman becoming unobstructed, followed by her slight smile. The actual release of shoulder contact occurs between or behind sampled occlusions.
uncertainties: Exact footwork and the mechanics of disengaging are not visible; neither is specified in the script.
shots.generation_prompt_en: For five seconds, stay close to the blonde woman in gray and the curly-haired man on the bar floor, her arm initially across his shoulder and the bun-haired dancer just behind. The curly-haired man turns across the foreground, briefly blocking the blonde woman; the bun-haired dancer then passes across as their close grouping opens. Settle on the blonde woman standing unobstructed, looking down before lifting her gaze with a small smile. Blue light washes her straight blonde hair and gray shirt, with vivid magenta along the opposite side. Behind her, the swept-haired dance partner and loose-haired dancer continue their dance, the woman opening an arm outward. Preserve the dark bar interior and its small warm background lights.

adaptations.text: Condense the 5.464-second source to five seconds, using the visible foreground passages to bridge the change from shoulder contact to standing unobstructed.

global_prompt: Six five-second shots preserve the garage exchange, alternating close views, departure, floor-level mask pickup, and walking bag search.

Her small quilted Black shoulder bag hangs from a chain strap. The Brunette woman has long brown hair with lighter ends, a fitted black cropped top and blue jeans. title: Particles and butterflies beside a flooded tree
global_prompt: Four five-second animated shots preserve the root crossing, particle-cloud reveal, ascending butterfly, and infant's seated-to-standing action.

observed_facts.text: Painterly animation shows purple reflective water, exposed wooden roots, a huge reddish trunk at right, and a pale sky streaked with peach and cream.
The blue-dressed child starts at the left bank holding the purple book, is next airborne beside the arched root, and then stands on its crest with the book lying beside the feet.
The child raises hands near the face and head; bright pink, violet, and pale particles subsequently obscure the head and upper body.

shots.observed_camera: Wide view. Fixed environmental landmarks shift left together through frames 0–3, supporting a rightward pan that follows the crossing; the final framing remains similar.
shots.action_temporality: Bank departure precedes arrival on the root, followed by face-level gestures and particle buildup.
uncertainties: Exact footfalls and the book's placement gesture fall between samples. No internal cut is evident.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Five seconds of painterly 2D animation in warm peach light. Purple water surrounds exposed roots beside a massive reddish, deeply grooved tree trunk. A barefoot blue-dressed child with a dark brown bob crosses from the left bank onto an arched root perch, carrying a decorated purple book. Gently pan right with the crossing. Once the child stands on the crest, the book lies flat beside their feet. The child brings both hands near the face; vivid pink, lavender, and cream particles gather around the head and upper body.

adaptations.text: Slightly extend the source action to five seconds and simplify the unsampled crossing and book placement without specifying exact mechanics.

observed_facts.text: An overhead view shows the root perch and purple book in reflective water, with the massive tree base along the right edge and rocks at upper left.
A dense vertical cloud of pink, lavender, and cream particles thins, revealing a bald diapered infant seated on the root beside the book.
Several glowing white-outlined pink butterfly shapes change positions around the infant as particles scatter; the infant looks upward.

shots.observed_camera: Steep overhead view with stable root and tree-base framing; no evident camera movement or internal edit.
shots.action_temporality: Dense obscuration gives way to an increasingly clear infant while luminous butterflies remain in motion.
uncertainties: The cloud hides the transition between the prior child and the infant; no anatomical transformation is directly resolved.
shots.generation_prompt_en: From overhead, hold on the arched root perch in violet reflective water, the decorated purple book lying on its lower-right portion and the massive tree base filling the right edge. A dense column of pink, lavender, and cream particles loosens and disperses, revealing a bald diapered infant with thick dark eyebrows seated beside the book. Small luminous butterflies with white outlines and pink interiors flutter around the infant, shedding tiny sparkles. The infant tilts its face upward as the cloud clears. Maintain the painterly animated style.

adaptations.text: Stretch the particle clearing and butterfly fluttering from approximately 3.17 seconds to five seconds; depict a reveal without specifying hidden transformation mechanics.

observed_facts.text: A sharply tapering grooved trunk runs diagonally toward the upper right, ending in a tiny green growth against a swirling sky.
A luminous butterfly with pink wing centers and pale multicolored edges moves from left of the trunk toward its upper-right tip, becoming smaller and leaving scattered bright particles behind.
The sky and wood become cooler and darker across the shot, while the butterfly remains bright.

A radiant butterfly, with hot-pink wing centers and pale mint, cream, and white edges, flutters from the left of the trunk upward toward its upper-right tip. It becomes smaller as it ascends, trailing scattered flowerlike points of colored light. Over five seconds, the warm sky and reddish wood gradually dim into cool gray-blue and brown while the butterfly stays luminous. Use painterly 2D animation.

adaptations.text: Slow the approximately 1.79-second ascent and lighting transition to occupy five seconds; do not assert a connection to a particular butterfly or tree in another shot.

The seated infant spreads its arms. A small pink-and-gold glow appears at the upper chest, and later frames show the infant upright, then standing with knees slightly bent.
